notes:
- Requirements, bullet by bullet:
- Right column: met. `DashboardView.vue` changes the grid to `xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_400px_270px]`. Tailwind's `xl` is 1280px, and below that the grid is a single column, so the panel stacks.
- Three cards: met. `ContextPanel.vue` has the "Context" header and Docs, Memory and Graph cards, with 16px padding (`p-4`) and 13px rows.
- Docs header value (total count): met.
- Docs rows: partly met. `Updated this week` comes from `entries[].modifiedAt`. `Created this week` and `Read by Pilot this week` render `—`. The "muted secondary number" next to each count is not implemented. The issue says "where available", so this is acceptable.
- Memory: met as a `—` fallback. The header and all rows are `—`.
- Graph health word and tooltip: met for the Healthy/Drift/Stale words. The tooltip is a native `title` attribute. The 7-day and 30-day thresholds are the author's own assumption, as the code comment says.
- Graph rows: shown, but always `—` because nothing passes the `graph` prop.
- No bare percentage: met. The test asserts `not.toMatch(/\d+%/)`.
- Unit test for labels and the `—` fallback: met (`ContextPanel.spec.ts`).
- Acceptance bullet 2 is not shown as met. The PR evidence I was given has only build, test and lint output. It has no "Needs API" section listing the fields that fell back to `—`. Memory counts, graph stats, docs created and read counts, and memory created, updated and read counts all fall back. If the PR body lacks that list, the criterion is unmet. I could not see the full body, so I did not count this as a defect.
- Wire fields:
- The panel reads `entries[].modifiedAt` and `entries.length` from `DocsTreeResponse`. The producer is `getDocsTree` in the http adapter and `src/lib/api/types.ts`. I could not see those files, so I did not confirm the field exists there. The fixture in the test is typed as `DocsTreeResponse`, which suggests it does.
- The `graph` prop (`nodes`, `edges`, `updatedAt`) has no producer. The issue says to use the "existing docs/graph endpoints". The diff states that no graph endpoint exists, and I could not check that against `types.ts`. If one does exist, the Graph card is left unwired.
- Tests:
- They mount `ContextPanel` with props only, so the adapter wire contract is not exercised.
- `DashboardView`'s `loadContextDocs` has no test. That covers the use of `session.instances[0]`, which may not be a running instance, and the silent catch that turns any error into `—`.
- Migrations: none in this diff.
- Out of scope: no violations seen. Nothing is hardcoded and no values are invented.
- Minor: `text-needs-you`, `text-success`, `text-error` and `text-text-2` are Tailwind tokens I could not check against the theme. `vue-tsc` and the build would not catch an unknown class.
- Not reviewed: `src/lib/api/types.ts`, the http and mock adapters, and `src/lib/relativeTime.ts`. They are not in the diff.
